# PrintSheet

The A4 portrait printout of a set: thin–bold title, set meta, running order (slot, time in, track, BPM, key code and name, energy number with a greyscale patte…

`SongNodes.PrintSheet` · Pages

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.PrintSheet name="…" shape="…" slots={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.PrintSheet" name="…" shape="…" slots="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (PrintSheetProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` * | `string` | Set name for the title and footer. |
| `shape` * | `string` | Shape name ("Peak time (three waves)"). |
| `slots` * | `PrintSlot[]` | Running order, up to 24 slots per A4 page. |
| `genreMix` | `string` | Genre mix line ("House 50 · Techno 30 · UK garage 20"). |
| `url` * | `string` | Full URL of the view for the footer. |
| `dataFrom` * | `string` | Library freshness for the footer. |
| `notesColumn` | `boolean` | Adds the blank 30 mm notes column. |

### PrintSlot

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` * | `number; artist: string; title: string` | Slot number from 1. |
| `bpm` * | `number \| null` | BPM, one decimal at most. |
| `key` * | `string \| null` | Camelot code; printed with its name ("8A A minor"). |
| `energy` * | `number \| null` | Energy 1–10. |
| `playSec` * | `number` | Seconds this slot plays before the next comes in; drives "Time in". |
| `locked` | `boolean` | Locked slots print a lock icon. |
